title: R′ Chananyah of Kefar Tivon
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Sifrei, Haazinu, on “Unless their Rock had sold them,” according to the Yalkut’s reading; the text Hyman uses reads R′ Yehudah of Tiv’im.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Vocalized Edition of Sifrei Devarim 323, in the paragraph on “Unless their Rock had sold them,” names Rabbi Chanina of Tiv’in. This differs from both the supplied heading Chananyah of Kefar Tivon and Hyman’s reported Yehudah of Tiv’im. The precise Yalkut reading has not been freshly collated; its attribution remains Hyman’s report. The supplied forms are preserved with R′ for their uncollated abbreviated personal titles, without identifying the people or places.
